topic: National Institutional Integrity, Public Asset Audit, and Review Commission Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 20(1) (Ex Post Facto Criminal Protection)
findings.limitations: Absolute fundamental right; bars retrospective criminal laws and penalties.

findings.title: Commissions of Inquiry Act, 1952
findings.limitations: Inquiry powers lack direct civil contract quashing or asset recovery powers.

findings.title: Centre for Public Interest Litigation v. Union of India (2G Spectrum Case)
findings.limitations: Requires public asset disposition to be transparent, non-arbitrary, and evidence-based.

gaps: State land lease records subject to individual State Government registries; central asset recovery applies to Union land, central PSUs, and Union public service recruitment.
